research_report:
Cutoff and event. Research was frozen at 2026-08-05T17:40:39.196534Z, before the scheduled AMC disclosure. WDC is the post-separation HDD business; Sandisk results are no longer consolidated [S1].

Locked baselines. FY26 Q4 is the 13-week quarter ended 2026-07-03 [S3]. Management guided to revenue $3.65B ±$0.10B, non-GAAP gross margin 51%–52%, and WDC-defined non-GAAP diluted EPS $3.25 ±$0.15, with $385M–$395M opex, about $10M interest expense, about 16% tax, and about 385M diluted shares [S1,S2]. Pre-cutoff public expectations establish narrower neutral bands: Q4 revenue $3.69B–$3.71B and EPS $3.29–$3.35 [S5,S6]. The decision ladder therefore uses the relevant envelope edge rather than treating a management-guide beat as a market beat. For FY27 Q1, the TwelveData page displayed a 2026-07-24T19:59:00Z update with 16-analyst revenue of $4.02B and 15-analyst EPS of $3.73 [S7]. Revenue is definition-invariant and is locked with a $3.98B–$4.06B noise band. The $3.73 EPS figure is only corroboration because its capped-call/share convention is not auditable; Q1 gross margin can substitute. Q1FY26 contained 14 weeks, so raw year-over-year growth is not used [S3].

Operating transmission. Q3FY26 comprised 199 EB nearline plus 23 EB non-nearline, or 222 EB total; the contrary 222-EB nearline interpretation was withdrawn after checking the issuer deck [S2]. Cloud was 89% of revenue. EB, pricing, firm orders/LTAs, product qualifications, capacity and customer disclosures can confirm or veto a numeric conclusion but do not independently create a directional tier. The 40TB ePMR/UltraSMR program was expected to enter volume production in calendar H2 2026, while HAMR qualification/ramp was aimed at 2027 [S13,S14]. Previously public sold-out/LTA language and peers' strong capacity visibility mean generic AI-demand optimism is substantially embedded [S15,S16]. Customer concentration and changes to major relationships remain material falsifiers [S4].

Candidate adjudication. Only WDCUSDT-PERP.BINANCE is retained because it is directly linked to the reporting issuer. SNDK is an independent NAND company reporting the same evening, so its own disclosure dominates any WDC read-through. MU is a DRAM/NAND issuer whose substitution and common cloud-demand channels have ambiguous sign and timing. Both links were unanimously withdrawn by the three analysts absent an explicitly quantified direct dependency.

Reaction calibration. The mandated AMC window is WDC regular-session previous close to next close. Unadjusted WDC closes from Yahoo Finance were cross-checked against OptionSlam's event timing [S11,S12]: 2025-07-30, $71.43 to $78.69, +10.16% after Q4FY25 results and forward guidance [S8]; 2025-10-30, $138.13 to $150.21, +8.75% after Q1FY26 results and guidance [S9]; 2026-01-29, $278.41 to $250.23, −10.12% despite reported results above the prior range [S10]; and 2026-04-30, $434.52 to $431.52, −0.69% despite another strong operating package [S1]. The 2025-04-30 event was excluded because it was BMO. Four pre-separation AMC events (+4.75%, +4.72%, −9.72%, +2.76%) receive lower weight only for magnitude bins because their disclosures included flash economics. The evidence supports a ±3% no-action band; 3%–6%, 6%–9%, and at least 9% define weak, medium, and strong magnitude regions. Expected weak moves are the 3%–6% midpoint; medium moves are the 6%–9% midpoint; strong upside is the median of the two clean positive observations, and strong downside is the center of the clean −10.12% and lower-weight −9.72% tail observations. Sell percentages are unsigned complete-event magnitudes. The two negative/flat reactions following broad beats show that headline actuals alone do not determine sign; forward revenue and margin corroboration and explicit contradiction controls are required.

Debate adjudication. All three analysts converged on the Q4 market envelope, the corrected 199+23=222 EB baseline, WDC-only candidate set, lower weighting of pre-separation events, and rejection of $3.73 as a standalone Q1 EPS gate. The remaining disagreements were resolved by using $4.02B only as a revenue center, allowing revenue alone to contribute only a weak forward vote, requiring same-direction EPS or gross-margin corroboration for medium/strong tiers, and using ±3% rather than ±2% as the no-action band. Quantified customer, capacity, qualification, supply, legal or financing facts outside guidance force HOLD rather than an inferred qualitative reversal.
analysis_brief:
### First-package extraction

Extract from the first complete official release and simultaneously posted earnings deck:

- FY26 Q4 continuing-operations revenue in US$ billions, non-GAAP gross margin in percentage points, and WDC-defined non-GAAP diluted EPS. Do not use GAAP EPS, which can contain retained-Sandisk and financing marks.
- FY27 Q1 revenue, non-GAAP gross-margin and non-GAAP diluted-EPS guidance. For ranges, calculate midpoint as `(low + high) / 2`; use a disclosed point unchanged.
- The fiscal weeks and period endpoints for both quarters. Q4 must be the 13 weeks ended 2026-07-03. Do not score raw Q1 year-over-year growth because Q1FY26 had 14 weeks.
- The diluted-share convention and any capped-call adjustment used in Q4 EPS and Q1 EPS guidance. Q1 EPS is eligible only if it matches WDC's disclosed non-GAAP convention; otherwise use gross margin as the outlook corroborator.
- Q4 total and nearline exabytes, cloud revenue share, latest-generation drive shipments, and any comparable historical table. These are confirmation fields, not required gates.

### Locked comparisons and calculations

Q4 neutral ranges are revenue $3.69B–$3.71B, gross margin 51.0%–52.0%, and EPS $3.29–$3.35. Material thresholds are $3.79B/$3.62B for revenue, 52.5%/50.5% for gross margin, and $3.59/$3.06 for EPS, with the first value positive and second negative.

FY27 Q1 revenue is compared with $4.02B: $3.98B–$4.06B is neutral, while $4.10B/$3.94B is materially positive/negative. A positive outlook confirmation is WDC-defined EPS at least $3.73 or gross margin at least 52.0% and no more than 0.5 percentage point below Q4. A negative confirmation is EPS at most $3.50, gross margin below 51.0%, or a gross-margin decline exceeding 1.0 percentage point. Material confirmation thresholds are EPS $3.85/$3.30 or gross margin 52.5%/50.5%, with a flat-or-better margin required for the positive case and a decline of at least 1.5 points sufficient for the negative case.

Optional operating calculations are `Q4 total EB / 222 − 1` and `Q4 nearline EB / 199 − 1`; report them as percentages. Resolve any restated category definition before calculating.

Comparison order: apply definition, period and completeness vetoes; test for material cross-sign conflict; then evaluate the broadest tier before progressively weaker tiers. An isolated signal, balanced opposing votes, or an ordinary package inside the neutral bands remains HOLD. Classification is impossible if Q4 revenue, gross margin or WDC-defined EPS is absent, if Q1 revenue is absent, or if the only needed outlook corroborator has an unresolved definition.

### Event-driven focus

- **Orders, pricing and nearline mix — confirmation.** Find the EB table plus exact sentences about pricing, firm purchase orders, LTAs, capacity allocation and cancellations. Rising nearline/total EB with stable or improving pricing supports the financial sign; volume growth attributed only to shipment timing weakens it. A disclosed cancellation or repricing falsifies the demand thesis.
- **40TB and HAMR execution — confirmation or HOLD.** Find an explicit qualification, customer-count or production-timing update against 40TB volume in calendar H2 2026 and HAMR qualification/ramp in 2027 [S13,S14]. On-time milestones confirm durability. A material delay weakens it; a quantified effect excluded from guidance requires HOLD.
- **Customer concentration — possible HOLD.** Look for a sentence or table identifying a major customer loss, order deferral, concentration change or renegotiation and any revenue/margin amount [S4]. Stable or expanding commitments confirm visibility. An unquantified material change keeps the result at HOLD; a quantified change is already represented only if the package explicitly says it is included in guidance.
- **Capacity, yields and supply — confirmation or HOLD.** Locate capex guidance, yield/capacity commentary, supplier constraints and outages; compare capex direction with the prior 4%–6% of revenue framework [S14]. Disciplined capacity and stable yields confirm margin quality. A material unquantified constraint or outage forces HOLD.
- **EPS and separation accounting — HOLD control.** Check the non-GAAP reconciliation, diluted shares, capped-call treatment, retained-Sandisk marks and financing items. A clean bridge confirms EPS usability. An unresolved convention conflict or an item outside guidance large enough to affect Q1 by at least $100M revenue, 50 bp gross margin or $0.10 EPS requires HOLD.

STRONG_BUY.condition: Using only the first complete official release/deck, take FY26 Q4 continuing-operations revenue, non-GAAP gross margin and WDC-defined non-GAAP diluted EPS, plus arithmetic midpoints of FY27 Q1 guidance on a confirmed 13-week basis. After all HOLD vetoes and material-conflict tests, require at least two material-positive Q4 readings—revenue ≥$3.79B, gross margin ≥52.5%, EPS ≥$3.59—with gross margin one of them; the remaining Q4 reading must not be negative (revenue < $3.69B, gross margin <51.0%, or EPS < $3.29). Also require a material-positive Q1 block: revenue midpoint ≥$4.10B and either same-definition EPS ≥$3.85 or gross-margin midpoint ≥52.5% and at least Q4's actual margin. No Q4 material-negative reading, Q1 revenue ≤$3.94B, Q1 EPS ≤$3.30, Q1 margin ≤50.5%, or Q1 margin decline ≥1.5 points may be present.

MEDIUM_BUY.condition: Use the same first-package, continuing-operations, non-GAAP and 13-week definitions. Apply only if STRONG_BUY is false and no HOLD veto or material cross-sign conflict exists. At least two Q4 readings must be positive—revenue >$3.71B, gross margin >52.0%, EPS >$3.35—with at least one reaching its material-positive threshold of $3.79B, 52.5%, or $3.59; no Q4 reading may be negative (revenue < $3.69B, gross margin <51.0%, EPS < $3.29). Require a positive Q1 block: revenue midpoint >$4.06B and either same-definition EPS ≥$3.73 or gross-margin midpoint ≥52.0% and no more than 0.5 point below Q4 actual margin. No material-negative Q1 signal—revenue ≤$3.94B, EPS ≤$3.30, margin ≤50.5%, or margin decline ≥1.5 points—is allowed.

WEAK_BUY.condition: Use the first official package and the same definitions; apply only after STRONG_BUY and MEDIUM_BUY are false and no HOLD veto exists. Count positive votes for Q4 revenue >$3.71B, Q4 gross margin >52.0%, Q4 EPS >$3.35, and Q1 revenue-guide midpoint >$4.06B. Count negative votes for Q4 revenue < $3.69B, Q4 gross margin <51.0%, Q4 EPS < $3.29, and Q1 revenue midpoint < $3.98B. Require at least two positive votes and more positive than negative votes. Permit neutral or one modest opposite reading, but prohibit every material-negative signal: Q4 revenue ≤$3.62B, gross margin ≤50.5%, EPS ≤$3.06; or Q1 revenue ≤$3.94B, same-definition EPS ≤$3.30, margin ≤50.5%, or margin decline ≥1.5 points. If Q1 EPS is definition-ineligible, ignore it rather than substituting another EPS measure.

HOLD.condition: Apply before directional tiers if the first complete official package lacks Q4 continuing-operations revenue, non-GAAP gross margin or WDC-defined non-GAAP EPS; lacks quantitative Q1 revenue guidance; leaves the fiscal period, continuing-operations scope, capped-call/share convention or a metric reconciliation materially unresolved; or contains conflicting release/deck values. Also HOLD if a customer/order/pricing, capacity/yield, qualification, supply, legal, cyber or financing fact is described as excluded from guidance and is quantified at ≥$100M Q1 revenue, ≥50 bp Q1 gross margin or ≥$0.10 Q1 EPS, or if a comparable material fact is acknowledged but not quantified. After vetoes, HOLD if material positive and negative signals coexist; positive and negative vote counts are tied; all Q4 metrics and Q1 revenue are inside their neutral bands ($3.69B–$3.71B, 51.0%–52.0%, $3.29–$3.35 and $3.98B–$4.06B); there is only one isolated directional vote; or none of the six directional conditions is met because the package lacks a clear edge rather than merely failing a stronger tier.

WEAK_SELL.condition: Use the first official package and the same continuing-operations, non-GAAP and 13-week definitions; apply only after STRONG_SELL and MEDIUM_SELL are false and no HOLD veto exists. Count negative votes for Q4 revenue < $3.69B, Q4 gross margin <51.0%, Q4 EPS < $3.29, and Q1 revenue-guide midpoint < $3.98B. Count positive votes for Q4 revenue >$3.71B, Q4 gross margin >52.0%, Q4 EPS >$3.35, and Q1 revenue midpoint >$4.06B. Require at least two negative votes and more negative than positive votes. Permit neutral or one modest opposite reading, but prohibit every material-positive signal: Q4 revenue ≥$3.79B, gross margin ≥52.5%, EPS ≥$3.59; or Q1 revenue ≥$4.10B, same-definition EPS ≥$3.85, or margin ≥52.5% with no sequential decline. If Q1 EPS is definition-ineligible, ignore it rather than substituting another EPS measure.

MEDIUM_SELL.condition: Use the same first-package, continuing-operations, non-GAAP and 13-week definitions. Apply only if STRONG_SELL is false and no HOLD veto or material cross-sign conflict exists. At least two Q4 readings must be negative—revenue < $3.69B, gross margin <51.0%, EPS < $3.29—with at least one reaching its material-negative threshold of $3.62B, 50.5%, or $3.06; no Q4 reading may be positive (revenue >$3.71B, gross margin >52.0%, EPS >$3.35). Require a negative Q1 block: revenue midpoint < $3.98B and either same-definition EPS ≤$3.50, gross-margin midpoint <51.0%, or gross margin more than 1.0 point below Q4 actual margin. No material-positive Q1 signal—revenue ≥$4.10B, EPS ≥$3.85, or margin ≥52.5% with no sequential decline—is allowed.

STRONG_SELL.condition: Using only the first complete official release/deck, take FY26 Q4 continuing-operations revenue, non-GAAP gross margin and WDC-defined non-GAAP diluted EPS, plus arithmetic midpoints of FY27 Q1 guidance on a confirmed 13-week basis. After all HOLD vetoes and material-conflict tests, require at least two material-negative Q4 readings—revenue ≤$3.62B, gross margin ≤50.5%, EPS ≤$3.06—with gross margin one of them; the remaining Q4 reading must not be positive (revenue >$3.71B, gross margin >52.0%, or EPS >$3.35). Also require a material-negative Q1 block: revenue midpoint ≤$3.94B and either same-definition EPS ≤$3.30, gross-margin midpoint ≤50.5%, or gross margin at least 1.5 points below Q4 actual margin. No Q4 material-positive reading, Q1 revenue ≥$4.10B, Q1 EPS ≥$3.85, or Q1 margin ≥52.5% with no sequential decline may be present.
